limitations: This compact derived snapshot is independently frozen. Full parent dataset availability is not required to run the example.
A fresh fit is part of this worked example. No prior fitted numerical object is reused.
No post-origin realized outcomes are distributed or evaluated.
Four paired paths do not establish predictive validity, policy optimality or a confidence interval.
Reward response coefficients are user-declared assumptions, not estimates learned by this example.

protocol_counter.basis: P-Chain reward counter, including open promises. Not realized ledger supply.
protocol_counter.integration: The freshly prepared validator-only model receives this earlier observation as its configured starting counter. No fitted coefficient or source row is changed.
protocol_counter.observation_clock: Immediately before the referenced commitment at23:56:46 UTC; not a proven complete end-of-day counter at23:59:59 UTC
protocol_counter.selection: Latest source commitment by start_time DESC, transaction_hash with accepted_at and start_time at or before the cutoff and non-NULL supply_before_navax. Original row is a delegator commitment; it is not fitted or simulated.

snapshot.filter: role = 'validator' AND accepted_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-18 23:59:59' AND stake_navax IS NOT NULL
snapshot.scope: Validator commitment terms available by the cutoff, including scheduled end dates after it. No realized reward, payment, removal or later acceptance outcomes are selected.
